data.description: Once per day, a great wyrm magma dragon can spit lava onto a target within 120 feet, dealing damage normally for its breath weapon. This magma cools instantly - it does not continue doing damage at this point but does entrap the victim (DC %1, 3d6 minutes, hardness 8, hp 45).
data.name: Magma Tomb
